title: GRR17 5-round AES Multiple-of-eight / four antidiagonals

target.description: Five nonlinear AES rounds with finalMC omitted. One complete source structure and four antidiagonal tests.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key; no related-key oracle.
setting.plaintext_model: 2^32 plaintexts in one complete diagonal set.
assumptions: Modulo8 acceptance of AES is exact under the stated construction; uniform/independent random-permutation residue tests are source approximations. pr=1-2^(-3s) is random rejection/advantage, not automatically balanced-prior classification accuracy.
setting.reference_model: Single-secret-key distinguishing versus a random permutation/inverse; four tests treated with source approximate random-rejection model.

time.note: Section3.3 headline, 4 * 3 *2^32 lookups rounded to2^35.6; oracle acquisition separate, no conversion to encryption equivalents.

preprocessing.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

success.description: Section3.2 approximately1-2^-12 from four antidiagonals; AES acceptance deterministic; independence is an author approximation.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.1–2/6 inconsistent summaries; p.7 round convention; pp.10–14 Sections3.2–3.5 counting, budget, inverse generalization.
evidence.interpretation: Complete registered proceedings read and AES claim inventory checked2026-10-26; work-level gates remain open as specified in the audit receipt. Source claims and unresolved fields retain their original status.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.3–4,8,13–16 / printed pp.1–2,6,11–14: consistent extended-edition headlines, Theorem 3 and Algorithm 1.
evidence.interpretation: The extended edition supports the original defining algorithm at 2^32 texts and approximately 2^35.6 lookups. Both conflicting original-proceedings observations remain; no formal erratum is asserted.

limitations: Both the registered proceedings and the separately hashed extended version have been read. The inverse proof is a D=1 sketch; the forward D=1,2,3 generalization is inspected. Source cost and success approximations remain attached.
